name: Dan's zsh config
description: Sets up zsh as default shell with [Dan's zsh config](https://github.com/dstockhammer/zsh).

failOnError.description: Whether to fail the container build if the feature fails to install.

zshHistory.description: The location of the .zsh_history file. Leave empty for default in Docker volume.

starshipVersion.description: Starship version to install, e.g. v1.27.0. Defaults to the latest release.
